items: 【Complete Hand Tool Kit Set】 This compact tool kit contains mechanic tools and equipment including wrenches, household screwdriver set, insulation tape, ratchet bit holder, extension bar, metric sockets, spanner set, screwdriver bits, electric test pen, spirit level, screw bits, spark plug, tape measure, transfer sockets, screws assortment trade pack, hammer, pliers set, cutter, multi tool blade, plastic ties, hand saw, saw blades, screws and wall plugs set and many other tools

【Multi-functional tool kit set for everyone】 Tool kit for men and women includes home repair tools kit, motorbike repair tools, bike repair tools and woodworking tools, suitable for use in a variety of scenarios, such as home, garage, apartment, shop, construction site, marine, etc. It can be used for home repairs, car repairs, handyman work and DIY creations and other jobs. The tool set is excellent present set for beginners, family, lovers, partners

【Portable Tool Box Set】 The small toolbox is compact and lightweight, it can be easily placed on shelves, spare cupboards. Whether it is used indoors or outdoors, the tool box kit is easy to take it everywhere. The toolbox is equipped with two sliding locks, which can be closed when the toolbox is not in use, preventing tools from being lost. It is neatly organised inside, all tools are tightly stored in the corresponding grooves, so that tools and accessories are not easy to fall out

【Good Quality & Ergonomic Design】 Each toolkit accessory is made of good quality steel with brushed chrome plated anti-corrosion treatment. The handle material of the tool accessories is ergonomically designed and comfortable to use. Under normal use, these tools will last a lifetime

【Support & Service】 We offer 12 months product service and customer service from the date of purchase and lifetime support to all our valued customers. If you have any questions, please let us know promptly and we will reply to you within 24 hours. Tips: When opening the toolbox, please place the side with "Sundpey" logo on the top to prevent the tools falling out from the box
